observations.seen: A single directional key throws long diagonal shadows in every venue. The Munich night pitch reads evenly lit with no floodlight pooling, and the Lagos dirt pitch is a flat orange wash with almost no value separation between pitch and stands.

Player cast shadows are crisp and consistent with the key direction, and the round contact blobs under feet ground the figures. In frame 2 the goal net and goalkeeper shadows fall onto noisy grass and lose definition.

The blue indoor court shows faint mirrored player reflections and one large specular hotspot. The grass in frames 1 and 2 has a glossy, wet sheen with white speckle that reads as a broken specular term, not as lit turf.

The crowd is rows of identical capsule billboards. The seating layout repeats across the Munich, Lagos and indoor frames with only a color swap. Stands are flat dark bands with no roof, rigging or haze depth. Only frame 2 adds a floodlight truss.
The recipe asks for indoor haze, but no haze, light shafts or depth falloff appears in any frame. Distant stands have the same contrast as the foreground pitch.

The grass texture is high-frequency noise with bright speckles and streaky smearing that shimmers at this scale. The dirt pitch is an untextured flat fill. The court surface is clean but plain. Kits are flat-shaded.

The players are low-poly figures with readable kits and skin tones, but their silhouettes are thin and stiff. The ball has a simple panel texture. The goal frame and net are acceptable. The crowd capsules have no form.

The centered kickoff frames are symmetric and readable, but the players occupy well under the 25–40% subject target and the empty pitch dominates. In frame 2 the action is pushed to the lower left, away from the goal on the right.
The high broadcast angle in frames 1, 3 and 4 is close to the recipe. Frame 2 switches to a perspective corner view that breaks the orthographic broadcast consistency.
Frame 4 has a heavy vignette and a blown bloom hotspot on the floor. Frames 1 and 2 show grainy noise on the turf. There is no unified arena-fight grade across the venues.
Frame 2 shows plausible running strides. The kickoff frames show rigid identical idle stances with no weight shift.
The scoreboard, possession bar, kickoff prompt and control hint strip are clean and legible. The top venue tab bar competes with the game view, and the possession bar sits detached below the score.

nextChange.change: add the recipe row's atmosphere (fog scale, haze, shafts) at the look's intensity
